# Register [Types every read of a flag from the generated module]

`Register` is an empty interface. `vexla.gen.ts` augments it with `definitions`, so `flags`, `vexla.get`, `vexla.evaluate`, `useFlag`, and the `decide` option read the types of the project. `Register` is an `interface`, since declaration merging requires it.

```ts [vexla.gen.ts]
// Generated by vexla. Do not edit.

export const definitions = {
  PRICING: {
    build: false,
    default: 'a',
    options: ['a', 'b', 'c'],
    public: false,
    type: 'select',
  },
} as const

declare module 'vexla' {
  interface Register {
    definitions: typeof definitions
  }
}
```

## Registered

```ts
// The registered definitions, or any definitions when the project registers none
type Registered = Register extends { definitions: infer definitions }
  ? definitions
  : Definitions.Definitions
```

| Declaration in `.env.flags`                        | Value type                      |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `@type {boolean}`                                  | `boolean`                       |
| `@type {number}`                                   | `number`                        |
| `@type {string}`                                   | `string`                        |
| `@type {'a' \| 'b'}`                               | `'a' \| 'b'`                    |
| `@type {json}` with the default `{"requests":100}` | `{ readonly requests: number }` |

## Generation

[`vexla generate`](/cli/generate) and the [Vite plugin](/api/vite) write the module. [`Definitions.generate`](/api/core/definitions) returns its source.
